title: Tails of the Super-Pets TPB (Trade Paperback, DC Comics, 2022) Robert Bernstein
descriptionText:
Tails of the Super-Pets TPB (Trade Paperback, DC Comics, 2022) – Classic Silver Age Stories!
Condition: Very Good / Like New
🐶 Description:
Celebrate the wacky, wonderful world of DC’s most loyal heroes — the Super-Pets! This vibrant trade paperback collects classic Silver Age adventures starring Krypto the Superdog, Streaky the Supercat, Comet the Super-Horse, Beppo the Super-Monkey, and Ace the Bat-Hound — along with appearances from Superman, Supergirl, Batman, Wonder Woman, and more.
These timeless stories capture the charm and imagination of early DC Comics, restored and reprinted for a new generation of fans and collectors.
📚 Includes Classic Stories From:
Action Comics #261, 266, 277, 292, 293
Adventure Comics #210, 256, 293, 322, 364
Batman #125
Superboy #76
Superman #176
Wonder Woman #23
🖋️ Featuring Legendary Creators:
Jerry Siegel, Otto Binder, Bill Finger, Leo Dorfman, William Moulton Marston, Curt Swan, Jim Mooney, George Papp, Sheldon Moldoff, Harry G. Peter, and more!
💥 Highlights:
Features the classic story “The Battle of the Super-Pets!”
Perfect for fans of the DC League of Super-Pets movie or vintage comics.
Bright, colorful art and all-ages storytelling.
📖 Book Details:
Publisher: DC Comics
Release Year: 2022
ISBN: 978-1-77951-339-7
Cover Price: $19.99 USD
Format: Softcover / Trade Paperback
Genre: Superhero, All-Ages, Humor
📸 Condition Notes:
Excellent condition — gently handled, looks unread.
Crisp pages and spine, vibrant cover colors.
No writing, tears, or major flaws (see photos for details).
